critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1511-1520 — Fix correctly applied. Loop iterates raw = body.dict(exclude_unset=True); for prize_description/description keys: strip + treat empty as None; other keys pass-through. Note: `if v is None: continue` before the special-case means if client explicitly sends prize_description=null (not empty string) the field will NOT be cleared. If clearing via explicit null is a desired UX, main agent may consider allowing None for these two nullable fields. Not blocking — empty string path (main UX from form) is now correct.
